cases.name: self-harm gets the crisis card, even at the limit
cases.message: I want to end my life

cases.name: emergency gets the urgent-care card
cases.message: I have chest pain and feel dizzy

cases.message: What dose of metformin should I take?

cases.name: at the limit, an ordinary question gets the limit state

expect.contains: You're in your luteal phase right now

expect.firstSentence: I don't have reliable information on that. A doctor is the best person to ask.
